personality_one_liner: A calm, highly readable, and respectful spiritual utility designed with generous touch targets and warm contrast for an older demographic.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing to aid readability and tap accuracy for older demographics.

do's: Use over the tab bar to let scrollable content bleed through softly
Use behind the sticky bottom CTA container in Vihar Detail so lists don't abruptly cut off
Apply subtle translucent blur to the header
dont's: Avoid on core data cards to prevent readability issues
Do not use on progress bars or form fields

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A welcoming dashboard showing the immediate Vihar to join, volunteer status, and upcoming sevas.

states.loading: Centered large spinner with 'માહિતી લાવી રહ્યા છીએ...' (Loading info...)
states.empty: Illustration of a walking path with text 'હાલમાં કોઈ વિહાર નથી' (No current vihars) and a button to view past sevas.
states.error: Message 'માહિતી લાવવામાં ભૂલ' (Error fetching info) with a prominent 'ફરી પ્રયાસ કરો' (Retry) button.

screens.layout: Header: Title 'નારણપુરા વિહાર સેવા' and greeting 'પ્રણામ, {name}'. Hero Section: 'આજનો વિહાર' Card. Must use image 'hero_vihar_path' with a heavy vertical gradient scrim (transparent to 80% surfaceInverse) to guarantee Gujarati text readability. Inside card: Date/Time, Route (From -> To), counts for Sadhuji/Sadhviji/Wheelchair. Below counts, a thick progress bar (surfaceTertiary track, brandPrimary fill) with text 'સેવકો 3/5 જોડાયા'. Massive full-width CTA inside card '🙏 હું સેવા માટે આવીશ'. Following sections: 'મારી આગામી સેવા' (My Upcoming), 'આગામી વિહારો' (Upcoming Vihars) in a vertical list.

screens.name: Vihar Detail
screens.purpose: Provides full context on a specific Vihar and allows the user to commit to it.

states.error: Error text with prominent Retry button.

screens.layout: Scrollable view starting with large Vihar route and time. A section for 'સેવા સ્થિતિ' (Seva Status) showing joined vs required volunteers. A list of confirmed volunteers with checkmarks (avatar initials in brandTertiary circles). Bottom: Sticky CTA container fixed at the bottom with a blur background. The CTA reads '🙏 હું સેવા માટે આવીશ' (Join) or 'સેવા રદ કરો' (Cancel) if already joined. The scroll view must have padding at the bottom equal to the sticky CTA height.

screens.name: History (My Seva)
screens.purpose: Showcases the volunteer's lifetime contribution and past sevas.

states.empty: Text 'તમારી સેવાનો ઇતિહાસ અહીં દેખાશે' (Your seva history will appear here).
states.error: Error text with prominent Retry button.

screens.layout: Top section: 2x2 grid of stat tiles (Total Vihars, Total KM, Sadhuji, Sadhviji). Each tile is surfaceSecondary, radius md, shadow 1. The number is text 2xl in brandPrimary. Below: Tabs for 'આગામી' (Upcoming) and 'પૂર્ણ થયેલ' (Completed). A list view of past sevas showing Date, Route, and KM. High contrast text.

screens.name: Profile
screens.layout: Cover image using 'profile_texture' with subtle brand tint. Avatar centered overlapping cover. List rows for Language toggle (Gujarati / English) and Logout. Large 48pt touch targets for rows.

screens.name: Admin
screens.purpose: Tools for organizers to manage sevas.
screens.layout: Simple vertical list of administrative actions. 'નવો વિહાર બનાવો' (Create Vihar), 'હાજરી પૂરો' (Mark Attendance), 'વોટ્સએપ પર શેર કરો' (Share on WhatsApp). High contrast forms with labels always above inputs.

hero_vihar_path.alt: A serene walking path through misty trees at sunrise, evoking a spiritual journey

profile_texture.alt: Warm, calm sand ripples creating an abstract textured background

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The app is for an older demographic. Do not scale down the typography scale. Font sizes start at 14pt (sm) and default body is 16pt (base).
CRITICAL: The app is Gujarati-first. Use `NotoSansGujarati` (Google Font) which ensures perfect rendering of complex conjuncts in Gujarati. Fallback to `Mukta` if needed.
Touch targets for ALL interactive elements (buttons, list rows, tabs) must be a minimum of 48x48 padding/hitSlop.

Implement the 'hero_vihar_path' image in the Home screen's 'Today's Vihar' card with the mandatory Gradient-to-dark Scrim Pattern (Layer 0: image, Layer 1: linear-gradient transparent -> >70% surfaceInverse, Layer 2: White Text). Ensure text contrast clears 4.5:1.
Ensure the Vihar Detail screen implements a fixed/sticky bottom CTA. The scrollable content must have bottom padding matching the CTA height so content isn't obscured.
The progress bar should be thick (at least 12pt height) so older users can easily gauge the 3/5 volunteer status.
No blue, purple, or indigo colors are permitted anywhere in the app per the <Colors> constraints.
Use MaterialCommunityIcons (e.g., `wheelchair-accessibility`, `walk`, `account-group`) as they scale well and have diverse metaphor coverage.
